title: Can you write a python code for converting IFC to CityGML with using semantic web

For this, first of all, IFC data should be defined ontologically and then logical mappings should be made between IFC-CityGML data. After that, the conversion process needs to be done based on these mappings. During all these processes, there should be no loss of geometric and semantic information in the data. Since these two data types can be visualized as 3D models, I need to be able to visualize the transformed data at the end of the process. You must to do all that using semantic web. For that you need to parse and convert IFC file first and than you need to write a logical converter for IFC/RDF to CityGML. And these are the source websites: For IFC: https://www.buildingsmart.org/standards/bsi-standards/industry-foundation-classes/?no_third_party_tracking=true For Citygml: https://www.ogc.org/standards/citygml?no_third_party_tracking=true I add a example ifc file on the project too.
